notes: Monitoring and staging update. The health address (health.php) now reports a cron job that has never recorded a run once its grace period ends (36 hours for daily alerts, 2 hours for the watchdog, counted from when the health address first saw it missing), instead of treating it as healthy forever. The staging copy script (dist/make_staging.sh with dist/staging_scrub.php) now scrubs every text column it does not explicitly keep, including homework, goals, portal requests, document titles and file names, task titles and session locations, and copies only cron/ and .htaccess from the private directory, never deployment backups. Includes 3.0.29 and 3.0.30. No database migration for sites on 3.0.28 or later; apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.28.sql (adds scheduled_sessions.checked_in_at) before updating files; sites below 3.0.27 apply mig_3.0.27.sql first. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16, 3.0.21, 3.0.27 and 3.0.28 in order; all are safe to re-run.
